d.d: Any of the subspecies of the moose (Alces alces, the largest member of the deer family, alternatively named Eurasian elk to avoid confusion with the wapiti), that occurs only in Europe and Asia.
Common wapiti (Cervus canadensis), the second largest member of the deer family, once thought to be a subspecies of red deer.
A highly-branched coral (Acropora palmata) supposed to resemble the horns of an elk.
